description: Publish a site folder: provider "bitpull" hosts it on BitPull itself with no other account (free, from the person's BitPull login; plan limits on the number of sites), "cloudflare" or "vercel" on the person's own account (builds it first when it has a build step). Puts it on the internet: the person confirms. Returns the job; follow it with site_job until it gives the address.
name: bitpull_publish_site
